.pp-wrapper {
  max-width: 600px;
  margin: 0px auto;

}


.pp-wrapper .welcome-card {
  text-align: center;
}

.pp-wrapper .username {
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffffff, #ffb84d);

}

.pp-wrapper .username-link {

}

.pp-wrapper .button-group {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, auto);
  gap: 12px;
  justify-content: center; /* centers the grid horizontally */
  margin: 10px auto;
}

.pp-wrapper .btn {
  display: block;
  min-width: 120px; /* ensures consistent button size */
  text-align: center;
  padding: 10px 0;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
}

.pp-wrapper .btn:hover {
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #6a0000;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
}

.pp-wrapper .search-section {
  margin-top: 25px;
  text-align: center;
}

.pp-wrapper .search-form {

}

  font-size: 0.95rem;

}

  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);

}

  10% { transform: translateX(-3px) rotate(-3deg); }
  20% { transform: translateX(3px) rotate(3deg); }
  30% { transform: translateX(-3px) rotate(-3deg); }
  40% { transform: translateX(3px) rotate(3deg); }
  50% { transform: translateX(-2px) rotate(-2deg); }
  60% { transform: translateX(2px) rotate(2deg); }
  70% { transform: translateX(-2px) rotate(-2deg); }
  80% { transform: translateX(2px) rotate(2deg); }
  90% { transform: translateX(0) rotate(0); }
}

    border-radius: 14px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);

    font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
}

.auth-form.auth-login {
    max-width: 460px;
}

.auth-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.auth-header h2 {
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
    color: var(--auth-primary);
    font-size: 1.65rem;
    font-weight: 750;
    line-height: 1.3;
}

.auth-header p {

    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.auth-error {
    margin: 0 0 1.2rem;
    padding: 12px 15px;
    background: #fff0f0;
    border: 1px solid #f2caca;
    border-left: 4px solid #c62828;
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: #a31515;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.auth-error:empty {
    display: none;
}

.auth-error .pad2,
.auth-error .err,
.auth-error .red {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    color: #a31515;
}

.auth-status {
    margin: 0 0 1.2rem;
    padding: 13px 15px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.auth-success {
    background: #edf8f0;
    border: 1px solid #ccebd3;
    border-left: 4px solid #15965c;
    color: #075e54;
}

.auth-success a {
    color: var(--auth-primary);
    font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.auth-success a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}

.auth-form > .pad2.green {
    margin: 0 0 1.2rem;
    padding: 12px 15px;
    background: #edf8f0;
    border: 1px solid #ccebd3;
    border-left: 4px solid #15965c;
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: #075e54;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    line-height: 1.6;

.auth-field {
    width: 100%;

    margin: 0 0 1rem;

    color: #333333;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 650;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.auth-form .auth-field input:not([type="radio"]):not([type="checkbox"]),
.auth-form .auth-field select,
.auth-form .auth-field textarea {
    display: block;
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 46px;
    padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--auth-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #222222;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: none;
    transition:
        border-color 0.2s ease,
        box-shadow 0.2s ease,
        background 0.2s ease;
}

.auth-form .auth-field textarea {
    min-height: 110px;
    resize: vertical;
}

.auth-field input::placeholder,
.auth-field textarea::placeholder {
    color: #999999;
    opacity: 1;
}

.auth-field input:hover,
.auth-field select:hover,
.auth-field textarea:hover {
    border-color: #b98b8b;
}

.auth-field input:focus,
.auth-field select:focus,
.auth-field textarea:focus {
    border-color: var(--auth-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(106, 0, 0, 0.09);
}

.auth-field input:disabled,
.auth-field select:disabled,

.auth-password-toggle {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;

    transform: translateY(-50%);

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    height: 34px;

    border-radius: 6px;

    cursor: pointer;
    transition:

.auth-password-toggle:hover {
    background: #f5eeee;
    color: var(--auth-primary);
}

.auth-password-toggle:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--auth-primary);
    outline-offset: 2px;
}

    display: block;

}

.auth-remember input[type="checkbox"] {

.auth-form .auth-submit {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 48px;
    margin-top: 1.25rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--auth-primary);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--auth-primary);
    color: #ffffff;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-align: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
        background 0.2s ease,
        border-color 0.2s ease,
        transform 0.2s ease,
        box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.auth-form .auth-submit:hover {
    background: var(--auth-dark);
    border-color: var(--auth-dark);
    box-shadow: 0 5px 13px rgba(106, 0, 0, 0.18);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.auth-form .auth-submit:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
    box-shadow: none;
}

.auth-form .auth-submit:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid rgba(106, 0, 0, 0.2);
    outline-offset: 3px;
}

.auth-form .auth-submit:disabled {
    opacity: 0.65;
    cursor: not-allowed;
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: none;
}

    margin-top: 1.25rem;

    line-height: 1.9;
